He is Associate Professor at CITA and leads the international Master Program Computation in Architecture.

Katrine Brahe Hall Katrine Brahe Hall PhD Research Fellow Katrine Brahe Hall is a PhD candidate and design historian examining the discipline of design management - the strategic and organisational dimensions of design practice - in the Danish design field since the 1970s. Her work explores how historical research can inform and enrich contemporary design practice, policy, and education.

Tor Erik Skaaland Tor Erik Skaaland Industrial PhD I am a paintings conservator with a museum background who does research on structural degradation of canvas paintings, with a special focus on paintings previously impregnated with melted wax-resin blends and the exhibition of such art works in historic buildings where the ambient climate and display conditions are difficult to control.

Nini Leimand Nini Leimand Associate Professor Industrial Ph.d., Co-head of BA Program, Boardmember I research and teach applied construction techniques and better building practices based on architectural quality and planetary boundaries. I am an architect MAA and associate professor at the Institute og Architecture and Technology at CINARK, Center for Industrialised Architecture.

Peter Bertram Peter Bertram Associate Professor I am head of the Master's programme Art and Architecture. I have written extensively about artistic method and the role of the art academy in society. I organize the Works + Words biennale in artistic research with the aim of developing international connections. My recent research concerns the role of architectural typology today.

Kristina Lindholdt Kristina Lindholdt Industrial PhD I am a PhD student specialising in architectural paint research and historical painting techniques. My research employs archival investigations, on-site investigations (analytical imaging, stratigraphic exposures) and advanced analytical methods, including optical microscopy, scanning electron microscopy (SEM-EDX) and FT-IR spectroscopy.

Jerry René Plagborg Jerry René Plagborg Industrial PhD I am an industrial researcher working at the intersection between the built environment and forestry. In my research, I aim to advance building and forestry practices that respect ecological boundaries.

Gabriella Rossi Gabriella Rossi Assistant Professor PhD I'm a researcher focusing on ML as a modelling paradigm, and how it can change architectural practice. I work with architectural datasets and their applications for complex material behaviour, sustainability, performance and adaptive robotic fabrication systems. I'm also an educator, teaching data literacy to architects internationally.

Arne Redsted Rasmussen Arne Redsted Rasmussen Associate Professor I am a Danish zoologist and researcher whose career has focused on marine reptiles, biodiversity, natural history, molecular science, forensic research, conservation, and natural heritage. Associated with the Royal Danish Academy, I have developed an interdisciplinary research profile, with particular expertise in sea snakes.
